吃完早饭，父母各奔东西，父亲去上班，母亲又和李奶奶、刘婶一起去挖野菜了。看见父母走了，小丫头拉着王野就要往外走：“大锅，糖，大锅，糖。”

王野吃惊地看着王笑笑，笑着说：“你个小丫头是要成精呀！”抱起王笑笑出门奔向供销社。王江河听着要买糖，也紧跟着出门。

“方姨，给拿一毛钱的糖块。”

方姨好奇地问：“小野，你昨天不是才买的糖吗？”

王野一脸沮丧：“咳，方姨，别提了，昨天买的糖回家就被我娘没收了。”

方姨指着王野说：“你是真惯着妹妹呀！”

王野假装无奈地显摆：“那有什么办法呀，谁让我们妹妹这么可爱呢！”

方姨点点头：“嗯，这丫头是真可爱。”

看着王野和方姨一直说话，小丫头急了，探着身子伸着小手说：“糖，糖。”

这一下就把方姨逗乐了：“呦呦呦，小丫头还急了，姨这就给你拿。”

方姨就要拿纸包糖块，王野赶紧说：“方姨，麻烦您给分两包吧，这儿还有一个小尾巴呢！”

方姨每包装了五块儿递给王野。一人一包分给王江河和王笑笑。两小只含着糖块，王野抱着一个，领着一个，往家走去。

刚到大院门口，就看见一辆吉普停在胡同里。这时代看见一辆吉普，比后世的劳斯莱斯都稀奇。所以围了一群看热闹的街坊。王野带着弟弟妹妹挤进人群，呦，熟人！猛的还想不起她的名字。

“王野，王野。”一个漂亮的姑娘拉着一位中年军装男人来到王野面前说：“爸，这就是王野，就是他救的我。”

随着记忆清晰，王野想起来了，这姑娘叫陈洛兮。就是前两天他救得那个落水女孩儿，因为当时他刚刚穿越过来，记忆有点儿模糊。

军装男子说：“小同志，谢谢你的救命之恩。”

王野摆着手说：“大爷，您客气了，都是应该的，当时我也是脑子一热就跳进水里了。这里不是说话的地方，走走，进屋说。”

军装男人拉着陈洛兮，跟随王野，一位看着是警卫员的年轻士兵，抱着一个箱子跟在后面。一起进了院子。

“江河，带着妹妹在院里玩儿。”王野吩咐王江河。放下妹妹，领着众人进了屋子说：“大爷您坐。”王野一边说一边给他们倒水，还客气地说：“家里没有茶叶，您多担待。”

“你不用忙了，来，你也坐。”军装男人指着旁边的一个凳子说道。

“小同志我……。”

王野打断男人的话：“大爷，您也别同志，同志的叫我了，您叫我小野就行。”

军装男人没想到有人敢打断他说话。

他不知道的是，王野精神力异常强大，天然对他自身的威势有抵抗力，再一个，对于一个现代人，“同志”这个称呼真不能说太好。

“好，那我就叫你小野，我呢，是名军人，不喜欢弯弯绕绕，我就直说了，第一呢！是感谢你的救命之恩，洛兮是我的宝贝女儿，救命之恩理应登门道谢。第二呢！就是送些礼品聊表心意，第三呢！就是看看你有没有什么需求。”

王野的心思急转，两世为人，眼前这位军人应该是自己见到的最大的官了，虽然不知道他的职位，但看着架势，又是吉普，又是警卫，职位肯定不低。转头又想：“老子可是有空间的男人，我怕个屁呀！”

王野不卑不亢：“陈大爷，既然你都这么说了，我也就不跟您客气了，我家的情况您也看见了，不知道您方便不方便给我安排个工作。”

After breakfast, the parents went their separate ways. My father went to work, and my mother went to dig wild vegetables with Grandma Li and Aunt Liu.Seeing her parents leaving, the little girl pulled Wang Ye out and said, "Big pot, sugar, big pot, sugar."

Wang Ye looked at Wang Xiaoxiao in surprise and said with a smile: "You little girl is going to become a sperm!" He picked up Wang Xiaoxiao and went out to the supply and marketing cooperative.Wang Jianghe heard that he wanted to buy candy and followed him out.

"Aunt Fang, give me a dime of candy."

Aunt Fang asked curiously: "Xiaoye, didn't you just buy the candy yesterday?"

Wang Ye looked frustrated: "Ahem, Aunt Fang, forget it. The candy I bought yesterday was confiscated by my mother when I got home."

Aunt Fang pointed at Wang Ye and said, "You really spoil your sister!"

Wang Ye pretended to be helpless: "What can I do? Who made our sister so cute!"

Aunt Fang nodded: "Well, this girl is so cute."

Watching Wang Ye and Aunt Fang keep talking, the little girl became anxious, leaned forward and stretched out her little hands and said: "Sugar, sugar."

This made Aunt Fang amused: "Hey, little girl, you're still in a hurry. I'll get it for you right now."

Aunt Fang was about to wrap the candy in paper, and Wang Ye quickly said: "Aunt Fang, please divide it into two packages. There is also a little tail here!"

Aunt Fang packed five pieces each and handed them to Wang Ye.One bag per person was given to Wang Jianghe and Wang Xiaoxiao.There were two little ones holding candies in their mouths. Wang Ye hugged one and led the other towards home.

As soon as I arrived at the gate of the compound, I saw a jeep parked in the alley.It is rarer to see a Jeep in this era than a Rolls-Royce in later generations.So a group of neighbors gathered around to watch the excitement.Wang Ye squeezed into the crowd with his younger brothers and sisters, yo, acquaintances!I can't even remember her name.

"Wang Ye, Wang Ye." A beautiful girl pulled a middle-aged man in military uniform to Wang Ye and said, "Dad, this is Wang Ye, he is the one who saved me."

As his memory became clearer, Wang Ye remembered that this girl's name was Chen Luoxi.It was he who saved the girl who fell into the water two days ago, because he had just traveled through time at that time and his memory was a bit blurry.

The man in military uniform said: "Little comrade, thank you for your life-saving grace."

Wang Ye waved his hands and said: "Uncle, you are so polite. You are right. At that time, I jumped into the water as soon as my head got hot. This is not the place to talk. Let's go and talk in the house."

The man in military uniform pulled Chen Luoxi and followed Wang Ye. A young soldier who looked like a guard followed behind with a box in his arms.We entered the yard together.

"Jiang He, take your sister to play in the courtyard." Wang Ye ordered Wang Jianghe.Putting his sister down, he led everyone into the house and said, "Sir, please take a seat." Wang Ye poured water for them as he spoke, and said politely: "There is no tea at home, please be patient."

"You don't have to be busy, come on, sit down too." The man in military uniform said, pointing to a stool next to him.

"Little comrade, I..."

Wang Ye interrupted the man: "Uncle, don't be gay. If you call me gay, just call me Xiaoye."

The man in military uniform did not expect anyone to dare to interrupt him.

What he didn't know was that Wang Ye's mental power was extremely strong and he was naturally resistant to his own power. Furthermore, for a modern person, the term "comrade" was really not a good word.

"Okay, then I'll call you Xiaoye. I'm a soldier. I don't like to beat around the bush, so I'll tell you the truth. The first thing is to thank you for your life-saving grace. Luo Xi is my precious daughter, and you should come to thank me for saving your life. The second thing is to send you some gifts to show your appreciation. The third thing is to see if you have any needs."

Wang Ye's thoughts suddenly changed. After two lifetimes, the soldier in front of him should be the highest official he had ever seen. Although he didn't know his position, looking at his posture, he was both a jeep and a guard, so his position was definitely not low.He turned around and thought again: "I'm a man with space, I'm so scared!"

Wang Ye was neither humble nor arrogant: "Uncle Chen, since you said so, I won't be polite to you. You have also seen the situation at my house. I wonder if it is convenient for you to arrange a job for me."
